tickets.name: Two Points
tickets.note: P.J. Washington Jr. to score the first basket of SAS at DAL. Early in the game he's got the green light shining bright, and he floors it! The market's snoozing on him. Wakey wakey, eggs and bakey!

tickets.name: The Starter
tickets.note: Jalen Smith to score the first basket of WAS at CHI. He's the big fella at center court for the Bulls, and the tip is where first baskets are born, baby! He takes more early swings than a batting cage at sunrise! Long price, big upside, and a whole lotta fun. Let's go!

tickets.name: Opening Set
tickets.note: Alpha Diallo to score the first basket of NOP at DEN. Here comes Diallo, and buddy, this one's got some sizzle! Long price, big upside, and a whole lotta fun. Let's go!

tickets.name: Jump Ball
tickets.note: Onyeka Okongwu to score the first basket of HOU at ATL. Center circle, bright lights, and Okongwu in the middle of it all. The tip decides more of these than anything else! His history in the circle says he gets up there first. Oh my goodness! Long price, big upside, and a whole lotta fun. Let's go!

tickets.name: Skyhook
tickets.note: Four games, four first baskets, and Washington is driving the bus! Washington hunts that first shot like it owes him money! The Bucks run their first set through Kuzma, and he lets it fly! First possession, first look, and Powell is ready to fire! Reid has the green light from the opening whistle! Buckle up, buddy, this one's got some juice!

tickets.name: Lob City
tickets.note: Washington leads this one, with Kuzma, Watson and Thompson riding shotgun! Opening minute, ball in Washington's hands, and he is HUNGRY! Kuzma hunts that first shot like it owes him money! Watson is the wild card, and wild cards win pots! Thompson is the sneaky one in the bunch, and sneaky is our favorite flavor! If this one lands, they'll hear it all the way up I-85!

tickets.name: Transition
tickets.note: It's Smith, Kuzma, Reid and Watson, four tips and four chances to light it up! Smith at the opening tip: first touch, first look, first chance! Opening minute, ball in Kuzma's hands, and he is HUNGRY! The Hornets run their first set through Reid, and he lets it fly! Here comes Watson for the Cavaliers, flying under the radar! Hold onto your hats, folks!

tickets.name: Run and Gun
tickets.note: Smith at the point, Kuzma, Sharpe and Gafford filling the lanes! It all starts in the circle, and Smith is standing right in it! Kuzma gets the ball early for the Bucks, and he does not hesitate! Sharpe at the opening tip: first touch, first look, first chance! Gafford rises for the Mavericks at center court. Win it and the ball comes right back to him! If this one lands, they'll hear it all the way up I-85!

tickets.name: Heat Check
tickets.note: Four games, four first baskets, and Diallo is driving the bus! Here comes Diallo for the Nuggets, flying under the radar! First possession, first look, and Kuzma is ready to fire! Powell has the green light from the opening whistle! Opening minute, ball in Reid's hands, and he is HUNGRY! Hold onto your hats, folks!

tickets.name: Buzzer Beater
tickets.note: Diallo leads this one, with Kuzma, Watson and Podziemski riding shotgun! Diallo at a big number, and buddy, that one's got sizzle! Kuzma has the green light from the opening whistle! Watson is the sneaky one in the bunch, and sneaky is our favorite flavor! Podziemski is the wild card, and wild cards win pots! Oh my goodness, put the kids to bed, we're going big tonight!

The Bucks run their first set through Kuzma, and he lets it fly! First possession, first look, and Powell is ready to fire! Reid has the green light from the opening whistle! Hold onto your hats, folks!
